lpStudio.subtitle: Ground a single lesson plan in your scheme of work, then watch it stream into the branded document — ready to review, repair, and publish.

batch.title: Batch generation
batch.subtitle: Pick a scheme of work, choose the lessons, and generate them in parallel. Each plan is saved as a draft you can review and publish. Keep this tab open while the batch runs.
batch.keyNotice: Batch generation needs an OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Add it to the environment to enable the Start button. You can still explore the form below.
batch.noSchemes: No schemes yet. Create one under Schemes first.
batch.noLessons: This scheme has no lessons. Pick another, or add lessons under Schemes.
batch.loadError: Could not load the scheme's lessons.
batch.concurrencyHint: How many to generate at once (1–8). 4 is a reliable default — higher is faster but more likely to hit provider rate limits.
batch.tooMany: That's {count} lessons; the maximum per batch is {max}. Deselect some.
batch.startDisabledTitle: Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY to enable batch generation
